note.message: mamelet on node web refused the part of the linux extension in its revision: invalid linux part: file "/etc/app/app.conf": the content is not the one approved (sha256 0000)
note.hint: see the reason (mamelet logs it too: journalctl -u mamelet on the node); a mamelet refuses a part it cannot read, so a mamelet older than this Control Plane is updated first (docs/mamelet-update.md)
